blocks.text: Imaging acceptance notes, four shop-floor SKUs

This is the working cut for WTS-TST-2023-024 on May 2, 2023. Owen Briggs asked for a written bound after the current path (Four SKUs on the bench, golden WTS-IMG-22H2-04) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host bench-03.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on skip Toughbook in the sample, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Block the golden if any of the four SKUs fail serial, BitLocker, or Intune join. Do not waive the Panasonic Toughbook because 'it is old.' I am not restating a hallway yes. skip Toughbook in the sample is out because That SKU is 11 of 62 floor boxes. Skipping it is how the April 6 dry run came back without a driver. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at skus=4, floor=62, tough=11, minutes=41.8, fail=1, bit=128, apps=3, hours=3.5. Sibling tickets WTS-4588 and WTS-SOP-2023-022. I will not reopen skip Toughbook in the sample in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Owen Briggs owns a leftover that is easy to skip: wds-01.whetstone.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (08): refuse on skip Toughbook in the sample, lock is four SKUs, three checks, no laptop demo as proof. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on WTS-4588.
Pass means the CNC app opens and the serial port enumerates. A pretty desktop is not a pass.

What a skeptical user would try first on bench-03.whetstone.internal: the path Owen Briggs actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on intune-01.whetstone.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
